require 'json'
directory = File.dirname(__FILE__)
request = STDIN.read
File.open(File.join(directory, 'requests'), 'a') { |f| f.puts(JSON.generate({ argv: ARGV, input: request })) }
index_path = File.join(directory, 'index')
index = File.exist?(index_path) ? File.read(index_path).to_i : 0
File.write(index_path, index + 1)
rows = JSON.parse(File.read(File.join(directory, 'responses')))
row = rows.fetch(index)
if row == 'hang'
  File.write(File.join(directory, 'pid'), Process.pid)
  sleep 60
end
print JSON.generate(row)
